41d246392a924dfe.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة درة الركائز للمقاولات العامة عن محامي بدوام كامل للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى المحامي مسؤولية دراسة القضايا، تجهيز ملفاتها، وجمع البينات والأدلة اللازمة. يشمل الدور تمثيل الموكلين أمام المحاكم والجهات الرسمية، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم وتوثيق العقود والاتفاقيات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال القضايا، تحديد نوعها، تحليل عناصرها، وتقديم الرأي القانوني بشأنها. تحديد وجمع البينات الخطية (الوثائق والمستندات) والشخصية (شهود الدفاع والإثبات) وأدلة الإثبات، وكتابة لائحة الدعوى وتحضير حافظات المستندات. تسجيل الدعاوى لدى المحكمة المختصة، متابعة تبليغ المدعى عليه، حضور الجلسات، مناقشة الشهود، وتقديم المرافعة حتى صدور الحكم. تمثيل الموكلين (مدعون أو مدعى عليهم) أمام مختلف درجات المحاكم، واللجان، والمجالس الرسمية، والمحكمين، وتقديم المدافعة والمرافعة والإنذارات والاعتراضات والمطالبات. المفاوضة بشأن العقود والاتفاقيات مع الجهات الرسمية وغير الرسمية، وصياغتها وتوثيقها لدى الجهات ذات العلاقة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمحاماة وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المحاماة. معرفة قوية بالإجراءات القانونية وأنظمة المحاكم. القدرة على تحليل القضايا وتقديم الاستشارات القانونية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في صياغة العقود والوثائق القانونية. القدرة على المرافعة والتمثيل القانوني الفعال. مهارات تواصل قوية شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على تنظيم العمل وإدارة ملفات القضايا بكفاءة. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل لهذه الوظيفة في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. نوع التوظيف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، والراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

41755e58e26f0577.description: About Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel is a diversified business operating across the Middle East, North Africa, and Turkey (MENAT region). With 75 years of history, the company began as a small trading business and a Toyota distributorship in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. It has since developed an extensive operational infrastructure, established the largest vehicle distribution network in Saudi Arabia, and accumulated comprehensive automotive expertise. This experience has led to diversification into new sectors that contribute to the 'infrastructure of life' in the MENAT region. The Role of Quality Supervisor Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Quality Supervisor to join its team in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on investigating technical problems and supporting service centers and dealers in adhering to repair procedures set by ALJACS, ultimately optimizing product quality and functionality. Key Responsibilities Analyze and prioritize technical reports from Service Centers and prepare field technical reports to address unclear submissions. Audit warranty procedures and claims at the center level, suggesting corrective actions in consultation with QAD management. Provide training to service, sales, and parts staff on product installation, function, and features to enhance awareness of ALJACS products. Assist in training production installers on product installation during launching phases, ensuring adherence to installation standards. Participate in new product conformity tests as required, reporting results and following up on improvements for identified weak areas. Visit customers who have submitted complaints to verify problems and issues during implementation and supervise repair processes. Submit market product reports detailing customer requirements and competitive comparisons. Monitor Service Center activities, including technical reporting, warranty business, and warranty parts storage, to ensure compliance with company standards. Impact and Strategic Focus The Quality Supervisor directly influences the quality of technical problem resolution through adherence to JACS standards. The role also has an indirect impact on sales performance. A crucial aspect of this position involves ensuring product installation launching is based on established installation standards, including involvement in new product conformity tests. Required Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience. Performance Indicators Achievement of supplier evaluation targets. Achievement of product evaluation targets. Contribution to customer satisfaction.

41241c82b5acdab8.description: About Rosewood Red Sea Rosewood Hotel Group aims to enrich lives and create lasting memories through inspired hospitality. The company values relationship hospitality, integrity, and excellence, fostering an environment where talent can thrive and careers can flourish. Every associate plays a vital role in creating exceptional experiences for guests, colleagues, and communities. Role Overview Rosewood Red Sea is seeking a Plant Supervisor - Engineering for Saudi Nationals to join its Engineering team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves working closely with operational departments to maintain high standards of safety, functionality, and guest comfort across the property. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the Plant Supervisor will support the day-to-day management of engineering operations and contribute to the effective maintenance of all facilities, equipment, and building systems. Key Responsibilities Supervise the daily operation and maintenance of plant equipment, utilities, and building systems. Support the planning and execution of preventive and corrective maintenance activities. Monitor equipment performance and assist in resolving technical issues to minimize operational disruptions. Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations and company standards. Coordinate with external contractors and service providers when required. Maintain accurate maintenance records, inspections, and operational documentation. Role Contribution As Plant Supervisor - Engineering, you will help ensure the efficient operation, maintenance, and reliability of the property's mechanical, electrical, and utility systems. This includes supervising engineering activities, supporting preventative maintenance programs, and collaborating with internal stakeholders to maintain a safe, compliant, and exceptional environment for guests and associates. Compensation and Benefits Rosewood Hotel Group offers a competitive compensation and benefits package. Employees also receive ongoing learning and development opportunities, along with the chance to build a career within a global luxury lifestyle and hospitality company. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion Rosewood Hotel Group is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all associates are valued, respected, and empowered to achieve their full potential. The company celebrates diversity and is dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive.

41729ac7b60a7e34.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جاش للخدمات الفنيه عن مهندس مواد للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة وتصميم المواد لمجموعة متنوعة من الصناعات، وتقديم المشورة الفنية المتعلقة بالمواد، والمساهمة في عملية التصميم الشاملة. الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تزيد عن 10 سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المواد وتصميمها للاستخدام في مجموعة متنوعة من الصناعات، وتقديم المشورة بشأن النواحي التقنية للمواد. المساهمة في عملية التصميم الكلية، وتقديم المشورة بشأن الأداء والجودة والتكلفة الاقتصادية للعمليات والمنتجات. توفير الدعم للمشاريع الهندسية، والمساهمة في العمليات، بما في ذلك التصنيع والتقنية والشراء. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال المواد. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تزيد عن 10 سنوات في مجال هندسة المواد أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم عميق لخصائص المواد وتطبيقاتها الصناعية. القدرة على تقديم المشورة الفنية المتخصصة حول المواد. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات المتعلقة بالمواد. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم المشورة والمساهمة في فرق العمل. القدرة على مواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال هندسة المواد. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة جاش للخدمات الفنيه. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المهندسين ذوي الخبرة الواسعة في مجال المواد على التقديم.

41db1a3b59c152d1.job_title: Senior Advisor Data Center Cabling Project Management
41db1a3b59c152d1.description: About the Role Dell Technologies is seeking a Senior Advisor for Data Center Cabling Project Management. This full-time role is based in Riyadh and involves leading the deployment of complex physical network infrastructures that support large GPU clusters, hyperscale environments, and mission-critical data center operations. The Senior Advisor will ensure quality, compliance, and successful project execution across AI and HPC environments. Role Overview As a Senior Advisor, Data Center Cabling Project Management, you will lead onsite deployment and delivery of large-scale data center cabling programs. You will serve as the primary cabling lead on customer sites, coordinating between internal teams, partners, and customers throughout the project lifecycle. This position contributes to enabling the next generation of AI and HPC infrastructure at scale. Key Responsibilities Lead large-scale data center cabling deployments, overseeing planning, execution, partner coordination, and delivery across multiple installation phases and data halls. Review and validate cabling designs, deployment documentation, Bills of Materials (BoMs), network topologies, rack layouts, and installation methodologies in collaboration with engineering and program teams. Manage cabling partners, schedules, risks, budgets, change control processes, and resource allocation to achieve project milestones and quality objectives. Direct onsite installation activities, ensuring compliance with Dell standards, industry best practices, safety requirements, and customer specifications. Drive testing, validation, customer handover activities, and stakeholder communications throughout the project lifecycle. Required Qualifications 5-10 years of experience managing data center cabling deployments within AI/HPC, hyperscale, or enterprise environments. Strong expertise in fiber, copper, and InfiniBand cabling systems, including large-scale deployments supporting GPU clusters and high-density architectures. Proven ability to lead complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, partners, concurrent workstreams, and customer-facing responsibilities. Solid understanding of structured cabling standards, installation best practices, data center quality processes, and site safety requirements. Excellent communication, organizational, risk management, and project planning skills. Work Environment and Travel This role is based in Riyadh and requires extensive travel across the Middle East region to manage onsite data center cabling deployments. Company Overview Dell Technologies is focused on enabling the next generation of AI and HPC infrastructure. The Data Center Cabling Project Management team is integral to the successful deployment of physical network infrastructures that support advanced computing environments.

412f2fa7b4517936.description: About the Role Kuehne+Nagel is seeking an Air Logistics Customer Care Specialist to join its team in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. This involves proactive communication and issue resolution to maintain service quality throughout the transportation process. Manage customer onboarding, including accurate setup and maintenance of customer requirements, rates, and service agreements within Kuehne+Nagel systems. Ensure information flow to Operational Care Centers (OCCs) for efficient shipment execution. Handle customer complaints professionally, coordinating with stakeholders for timely resolution. 41d11d48dcb10aa8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات عن معالج صحة فم وأسنان للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم خدمات صحة الفم الأساسية بهدف الوقاية من أمراض واضطرابات الأسنان والفم وعلاجها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية مقابلة المرضى وفحصهم ومراجعة تاريخهم الطبي لتقييم حالتهم الصحية الفموية. تقديم علاجات الأسنان الأساسية، بما في ذلك التنظيف وإزالة الرواسب، وملء التجاويف، وتطبيق الفلورايد، وإعطاء التخدير الموضعي. تقديم المشورة للأفراد والمجتمعات حول نظافة الأسنان، والأنظمة الغذائية، وغيرها من التدابير الوقائية والعلاجية لمشكلات صحة الفم. تحضير أدوات الأسنان وتنظيفها وتعقيمها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد أوعية المعدات. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقديم خدمات صحة الفم الأساسية بكفاءة. بيئة العمل يعمل معالج صحة الفم والأسنان ضمن فريق شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات في مدينة ينبع بالمدينة المنورة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة في بيئة عمل مهنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن عنه حالياً. تشجع الشركة المتقدمين الذين يمتلكون الشغف بصحة الفم والأسنان والالتزام بتقديم رعاية عالية الجودة على التقديم.

416cc10c7dff9c06.job_title: Senior Relationship Manager / Director / Executive Director
416cc10c7dff9c06.description: Our client is a leading global asset management firm with a strong international presence and an expanding institutional business across the Middle East. The firm offers a comprehensive range of investment solutions spanning fixed income, equities, private markets, real estate, and alternative investments, serving institutional and professional investors globally. As part of its continued growth in Saudi Arabia, our client is seeking a highly experienced Senior Relationship Manager at Director or Executive Director level to develop institutional relationships, expand distribution capabilities, and support the firm's long-term strategic growth in the Kingdom. Role Overview The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and expanding relationships with institutional investors across Saudi Arabia, with a primary focus on Riyadh. The position requires an established network of institutional clients, strong investment product knowledge, and significant experience in institutional capital raising and investment distribution. The successful individual will play a key role in strengthening the firm's institutional presence in Saudi Arabia while working closely with regional leadership and global investment teams. Key Responsibilities Institutional Business Development Lead business development and institutional distribution activities across Saudi Arabia, with a particular focus on Riyadh. Identify and develop new relationships with institutional investors and strategic investment partners. Originate capital raising opportunities across a broad range of investment strategies and asset classes. Introduce the firm's investment capabilities to prospective institutional clients. Support the expansion of the firm's institutional investor base in the Kingdom. Relationship Management Build and maintain relationships with sovereign wealth funds, government-related investment institutions, banks, insurance companies, pension funds, endowments, and leading family offices. Leverage an established institutional investor network to originate new business. Develop long-term relationships with key investment decision-makers. Conduct regular investor meetings, presentations, and strategic discussions. Strengthen relationships with Tier I and Tier II family offices and ultra-high-net-worth investors. Investment Solutions & Distribution Promote investment strategies across fixed income, credit, equities, alternatives, and other relevant asset classes. Work closely with global investment specialists to present appropriate solutions to institutional investors. Understand institutional investor requirements, investment mandates, and allocation priorities. Coordinate investor engagement with relevant portfolio management and investment teams. Support capital raising initiatives and investment strategy discussions. Market Intelligence & Strategic Development Monitor investment trends, institutional capital allocation priorities, and market developments within Saudi Arabia. Provide strategic insights and investor feedback to regional leadership. Maintain accurate records of client meetings, prospective investors, and business development activities. Contribute to institutional coverage strategies and regional growth initiatives. Identify opportunities for further expansion across the Saudi institutional investment market. Candidate Requirements Minimum 10–15+ years of experience in institutional relationship management, business development, or investment distribution. Strong background within asset management, investment banking, financial institutions, private equity, or related investment businesses. Established institutional investor network in Riyadh and the wider Saudi Arabian market. Existing relationships with sovereign wealth funds, financial institutions, pension funds, insurance companies, endowments, and leading family offices. Demonstrated experience in institutional capital raising, business origination, and strategic relationship development. Strong understanding of institutional investment products and asset management distribution. Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. Fluent English, both written and spoken. Commercially driven, proactive, confident, and capable of operating independently. Preferred Qualifications Existing institutional relationships across other GCC markets. Strong knowledge of fixed income and credit investment strategies . Currently based in Riyadh. Saudi nationality would be advantageous. Arabic language proficiency would be a significant advantage. The Opportunity Join a leading global asset management firm with an established international investment platform. Take a senior role in expanding institutional distribution across Saudi Arabia. Develop strategic relationships with some of the region's most significant institutional investors. Work closely with international investment teams and regional leadership. Access a diversified range of investment solutions and institutional strategies. Benefit from a comprehensive employment package, including healthcare coverage, annual leave, and additional employee benefits.

41adb1e755433582.description: About the Role NES Global Talent is seeking an experienced Cementing Engineer for a contract position. This role involves planning, executing, and supervising cementing operations to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality service delivery. The Cementing Engineer will be responsible for designing cement programs and maintaining well integrity. Role Overview The primary objective of this position is to oversee field execution, troubleshoot operational challenges, and ensure compliance with industry standards. The role requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in cementing operations, focusing on both primary and remedial cementing jobs. Key Responsibilities Design and execute primary and remedial cementing jobs. Monitor cementing operations and ensure compliance with HSE standards. Evaluate well conditions and recommend appropriate slurry designs and cementing techniques. Prepare technical reports and post-job evaluations. Coordinate with drilling, completion, and operations teams to ensure successful job execution. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. 5+ years of experience in cementing operations with an oilfield service company. Strong knowledge of cementing, pressure pumping, slurry design, and well integrity. Experience in onshore/offshore operations and HPHT environments is preferred. 41d67afcc9c135e0.description: Job Title: Supply Chain Director Department: Group Supply Chain & Logistics Reports To [Group Chief Executive Officer (CEO) / Group Chief Operating Officer (COO)] Employment Type: Full-Time About the Company: The company is a diversified group of subsidiary companies operating across Saudi Arabia. We deliver comprehensive solutions across multiple sectors, supported by an extensive network of shared logistics, transportation, and warehousing assets. As we continue to scale in alignment with Vision 2030, we are transforming our supply chain operations to drive group-wide synergies, leverage advanced digital technologies, and deliver unmatched operational and customer service excellence. Role Summary / Purpose: The Supply Chain Director is a highly strategic, executive leadership role critical to consolidating and optimizing logistics operations across our entire group of subsidiary companies. This role is responsible for seamlessly integrating disparate logistics operations—spanning separate fleets, warehouses, systems, and processes—into a single, unified, and highly efficient supply chain network covering both land and sea transport modalities. The ideal candidate will drive digital and AI-enabled performance to maximize financial and operational outcomes while delivering exceptional customer service. Crucially, the Supply Chain Director must achieve these ambitious goals not through direct, day-to-day personal execution, but through robust strategic planning and the effective delegation through the line, empowering and holding accountable a comprehensive management team beneath them. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Integration & Network Optimization Develop and execute a comprehensive group-wide supply chain and logistics strategy covering all subsidiary companies. Lead the integration of disparate logistics operations (unifying separate fleets, warehouses, IT systems, vendors, and processes) into an efficient, scalable, and unified supply chain. Drive strategic planning, network design, capacity planning, and robust contingency/risk management protocols. Ensure seamless nationwide logistics coverage across all regions of Saudi Arabia (Central, Western, Eastern, Southern, and Northern), supporting major industrial zones and giga-projects in key cities including Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Makkah, and Madinah. Operations & Asset Management Directly manage transportation and warehousing assets on behalf of the group, consolidating shared logistics resources to maximize asset utilization. Oversee a multimodal logistics network encompassing both land and sea freight, covering inbound, outbound, intercompany, and last-mile movements. Negotiate and strategically manage contracts with land and sea carriers, 3PLs, warehouse providers, and other critical logistics partners. Ensure strict compliance with Saudi regulations, customs laws, transport directives, safety standards, and broader Vision 2030 alignment. Digital Transformation & AI Application Champion the digital transformation of group logistics through the implementation and optimization of ERP, TMS, WMS, telematics, IoT, and automation systems. Apply artificial intelligence (AI) and advanced analytics to maximize operational performance and financial outcomes, specifically driving initiatives in route optimization, demand forecasting, predictive maintenance, dynamic pricing, and dynamic capacity planning. Performance Management & Leadership (Delegation Through the Line) Build, lead, and mentor a robust management team, achieving operational and strategic results strictly through effective delegation through the line. Foster a culture of accountability, empowerment, and continuous improvement, allowing the management team to independently execute while adhering to group strategy. Design, implement, and govern operations through detailed performance KPIs that meticulously track both operational success factors and customer service outcomes. Establish strict governance, SOPs, and regular performance review cadences across all subsidiary logistics operations. Collaborate closely with subsidiary leadership, finance, procurement, operations, and commercial teams to drive cost optimization and working capital efficiency. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): The Supply Chain Director will manage the management team against a comprehensive framework of KPIs, including but not limited to: Operational KPIs: On-time delivery (OTD), fleet utilization rates, warehouse throughput, cost per km/ton, inventory accuracy, asset downtime, safety incidents, fuel efficiency, and order cycle time. Customer Service KPIs: Order fulfillment rate (OFR), customer satisfaction (CSAT), service level agreement (SLA) adherence, complaint resolution time, delivery accuracy, and reverse logistics/returns handling efficiency. Financial KPIs: Total logistics cost as a percentage of revenue, realized cost savings through consolidation, working capital improvement, and ROI on digital/AI system investments. Strategic KPIs: Subsidiary integration milestones achieved, digital system adoption rates, and AI-driven performance gains (e.g., measurable improvements in route efficiency or demand forecasting accuracy). Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. An MBA or relevant Master’s degree is highly preferred. 15+ years of extensive supply chain and logistics experience, including at least 5–7 years in a senior executive leadership role managing multi-site, multi-subsidiary operations. Proven, in-depth experience navigating the logistics and regulatory landscape of Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. Deep operational expertise in land and sea transport, large-scale warehousing, fleet management, and 3PL vendor management. Demonstrated success in integrating disparate subsidiary logistics operations into a centralized, unified supply chain network. Proven ability to achieve strategic results through "delegation through the line" rather than micro-management, empowering full management teams to execute effectively. Hands-on leadership experience in deploying and managing digital automated systems (ERP, TMS, WMS, IoT, Telematics) and applied AI solutions within a supply chain context. Exceptional financial acumen, contract negotiation capabilities, and vendor management skills. Language: Bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English is [mandatory / strongly preferred]. Competencies & Skills: Strategic Planning & Network Design Complex Systems & Operations Integration Operational & Customer Service Excellence Digital Fluency & AI/Analytics Literacy Financial Modeling & Cost-to-Serve Optimization Executive Negotiation & Vendor Management Empowering Leadership & Effective Delegation Change Management & Subsidiary Alignment Cultural Awareness & Cross-functional Collaboration Working Conditions Primarily office-based at the Group HQ, with frequent travel across all regions of Saudi Arabia and to subsidiary operational sites. The administrator will manage Linux operating systems, backup infrastructure, storage integrations, monitoring tools, and recovery processes while maintaining compliance with organizational policies and service level agreements (SLAs). ______________ Key Responsibilities Linux Administration • Install, configure, and maintain Linux operating systems (RHEL, Rocky Linux, CentOS, Ubuntu, SUSE). • Perform server provisioning, patching, upgrades, and lifecycle management. • Monitor system performance, availability, and capacity utilization. • Manage user accounts, permissions, groups, and authentication services. • Configure and maintain services such as Apache, Nginx, SSH, DNS, NTP, and FTP. • Troubleshoot Linux OS, network, storage, and application issues. • Implement security hardening and vulnerability remediation. • Perform kernel and operating system upgrades with minimal downtime. • Manage virtualization platforms and cloud-hosted Linux workloads. Backup & Recovery Administration • Administer enterprise backup solutions such as Commvault, Veeam, NetBackup, Rubrik, or Dell Networker. • Configure backup policies, schedules, retention periods, and storage targets. • Monitor backup jobs and resolve backup failures. • Perform restore operations for files, databases, virtual machines, and applications. • Conduct periodic backup validation and recovery testing. • Support Disaster Recovery (DR) planning and testing activities. • Ensure backup compliance with business continuity and regulatory requirements. • Optimize backup performance and storage utilization. Monitoring & Automation • Develop automation scripts using Bash, Python, or Ansible. • Monitor infrastructure using tools such as Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana, or SolarWinds. • Generate operational reports and capacity planning recommendations. • Maintain documentation for systems, procedures, and recovery processes. Security & Compliance • Implement Linux security best practices. • Manage SSL certificates and encryption standards. • Support security audits and compliance initiatives. • Maintain backup encryption and data protection controls. ______________ Required Qualifications Education • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. • Equivalent practical experience may be considered. Experience • 3-8 years of experience in Linux system administration. • Hands-on experience with enterprise backup platforms. • Experience supporting production and mission-critical environments. Technical Skills • Linux (RHEL, Rocky Linux, Ubuntu, SUSE). • Shell scripting (Bash). • Python automation. • Backup technologies (Commvault, Veeam, NetBackup, Rubrik). • Storage technologies (SAN, NAS, NFS, CIFS). • VMware, Hyper-V, or cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). • DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, Firewall concepts. • Monitoring and alerting tools. • Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity processes. ______________ Preferred Certifications • Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) • Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) • Linux Professional Institute Certification (LPIC) • Commvault Certified Professional • Veeam VMCE • ITIL Foundation • AWS, Azure, or GCP Administrator Certifications
